result.message: Good consolidation opportunity: your reads correctly showed P_EE22XRGDIJ → N_3W65MMQTBR → goal, and your first route confirmed that first hop worked (receipt matched!). But repeating the same ROUTE P_EE22XRGDIJ command at the new node failed—that port wasn't valid there anymore. The lesson: after arriving at a new CURRENT node, check its listed PORTS fresh rather than reusing a prior action. What port was actually listed at N_3W65MMQTBR?
result.rationale: Distinguishing the successful first hop (evidence-grounded, matched receipt) from the failed second attempt (invalid_route error from reusing a stale port command instead of using the newly listed port P_YOANUQISN6). Encouraging the learner to self-diagnose the mistake without supplying the gold action directly.
